basis.rule: Historical source map. Later source or execution requires an explicit update; membership, a test reference and a job count are distinct claims.

evidence_states.source_reference: Exact source bytes and the named executable method/factory were read and linked. This does not assert an execution or exhaustive coverage.
evidence_states.attributed_execution_record: The linked original-output receipt is attributed to its exact checkout and scope. Only explicitly linked case claims receive that qualification.
evidence_states.reviewed_limitation: Requires a precise invariant, reason and actual criterion-specific receiving review. None are newly granted by this inventory.
evidence_states.pending: Missing mapping, execution join or receiving decision remains explicit and cannot count as accepted coverage.

schema_inventory.title: AI Builder common types
schema_inventory.reference_scope: shared definitions reached by referring documents

schema_inventory.title: Auditable cost estimate based on pinned build and pricebook
Bidirectional invalidation graph for component dependencies
Deployment evidence and explicit approval manifest
Deterministic compatibility evaluation for a pinned build revision
Measured quality/safety evaluation evidence, separate from compatibility
Version-pinned external compute and model-capacity estimates

component_registry.interpretation: Frozen tier/cardinality/activation metadata is reproduced exactly. In particular T6 optional metadata is not a new decision about mandatory planning, runtime editing or deployment readiness.

schema.examples.method: all canonical examples pass and embedded objects validate independently

schema.version.method: future version extra fields and invalid enum rejected

schema.kind.method: unknown kinds and kind spec mismatch rejected

schema.decimal-date.method: decimal numbers and malformed timestamps rejected

schema.external.method: hostile schema properties are data and unknown schema loads fail closed

schema.parse.method: malformed input fails before schema evaluation

money.lexeme.method: money retains decimal lexeme and exact large magnitude

money.invalid.method: invalid decimal shapes fail instead of coercing to zero

money.shape.method: money rejects numeric amount missing and extra fields and unknown currency shape

version.value.method: version check rejects future absent numeric and null versions

integer.raw.method: every frozen integer minimum compares raw values without narrowing

integer.coverage.method: coverage names every integer minimum and actual nested receivers enforce it

integer.ordinary.method: ordinary numeric bounds remain exact and validation preserves input spelling and syntax gates

integer.local-budget.method: local catalog and pricebook projections enforce expanded revision budget after valid schema intake

history.partial.method: empty and partially entered drafts preserve unanswered fields

history.optional.method: all optional activation combinations are independent and retain inputs

history.alias.method: input aliases and exposed collections cannot rewrite revisions

history.restore.method: edit restore edit leaves history intact and preserves current metadata

history.cas.method: duplicate edits are no ops but stale and foreign heads conflict

history.same-restore.method: restore matching content still creates new identity and stale repeat conflicts

history.concurrent.method: simultaneous edits have exactly one winner and retain losing input

store.partial.method: empty partial and populated inputs reopen without invented values

store.cas.method: stale missing and foreign tokens cannot overwrite current revision

store.corrupt.method: unknown version malformed truncated and unknown fields remain intact and block save

store.reset.method: disk corruption is explicit and never reset to empty

store.interruption.method: preactivation failure keeps prior acknowledged state and postactivation reports uncertainty

store.cleanup.method: outer cleanup failure after activation is uncertain never a failed save

store.limit.method: excessive input rejected without overwriting previous draft

store.concurrent.method: concurrent writers cannot both acknowledge same expected head

store.lock.method: outer file lock blocks reads and writes without touching data

store.initialize.method: failed parent sync cannot yield a store and retry syncs existing child before use

graph.direct.method: both directions follow direct adjacency without transitive policy expansion

graph.modes.method: mode changes include edges active before or after and unknown is conservative

graph.activation.method: every activation follows the frozen website truth table

graph.removed.method: disabled tier and removed identities remain rechecked without editing input

graph.cycles.method: cycles self loops duplicates and input order produce finite deterministic output

price.evidence.method: candidate preserves pricebook revision and always requires evidence review

price.binding.method: exact version meter region and currency cannot silently fall back

price.interval.method: explicit start inclusive and conservative end exclusive including offset equivalence

price.unknown.method: missing region conditions and estimate prices remain unresolved

price.ambiguous.method: alternatives remain ambiguous and duplicate IDs reject document

price.invalid.method: invalid schema reversed interval and malformed bytes fail closed without disclosure

evidence.legacy.method: legacy verified establishes neither independent support nor an actual source reading

evidence.status.method: all raw statuses retain their separate meanings

evidence.support.method: independent support requires explicit reviewed assessment not a reference alone

evidence.origin.method: reviewed support never erases estimated or user supplied origin

evidence.binding.method: assessment for another claim version or snapshot cannot verify selected evidence

evidence.pinned.method: pinned fact retains exact identity and explicitly absent capture date

evidence.current.method: current state uses its capture timestamp without elapsed age expiration

evidence.recapture.method: new capture does not mutate historical presentation or reuse its reviewed support

analysis.order.method: out of order success and failure cannot replace newest report

analysis.retry.method: same identity retry and duplicate callback cannot win

analysis.cancel.method: cancellation and clear reject pending callbacks

analysis.bindings.method: every binding input invalidates even when revision stays the same

analysis.capacity.method: capacity evidence replacement rejects earlier estimator result

analysis.foreign.method: tickets from different coordinators cannot complete requests

analysis.concurrent.method: concurrent terminal callbacks have exactly one winner

evaluate.binding.method: foreign catalog and rules locks reject before report creation

evaluate.budget.method: budget exhaustion never emits a partial compatible report

evaluate.work.method: recursive container containment charges nested comparisons

evaluate.unsupported.method: reference exceptions stay unsupported rather than invented verdicts

evaluate.raw.method: raw numeric spelling reaches the strict reader unchanged

evaluate.duplicate.method: duplicate identities reject across all three documents

evaluate.ambiguous.method: ambiguous selections remain unknown without guessing first match

evaluate.pointer.method: ASCII array pointer preserves leading zeros and missing paths

evaluate.precision.method: derived VRAM accepts exact 28 digits and rejects a rounded 29 digit product

evaluate.goldens.method: supported Python goldens match complete reports

retained.configuration.method: complete retained configuration goldens preserve reference reports and explicit input authority

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Canonical top-level and embedded examples validate; extra fields, unknown kinds, mismatched kind/spec, future versions and invalid enums reject.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: Representative negatives do not enumerate every schema property or every kind/operation combination.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Unknown remote, file and traversal schema identifiers fail closed; duplicate-key malformed input fails before schema evaluation.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: No deployed API transport or server behavior is implied.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Exact magnitude and decimal spelling survive; invalid numeric strings and numeric money amounts reject rather than coerce to zero.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: Exact contract-value arithmetic does not establish a verified price or complete estimate.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: The factory probes each discovered integer minimum with raw spellings; a separate recursive inventory requires every integer-minimum location, and nested receivers reject negatives.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: This mechanically complete minimum-location check is narrower than all schema constraints or every consumer operation.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Schema-valid large integers remain exact; local projections accept their documented expanded revision budget and reject larger values explicitly.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: Schema admissibility and local projection limits are distinct; this is not cross-client arbitrary-number parity.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Registry kinds, tier and selection settings match schema definitions and example items; graph/rules reference registered kinds.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: Registry membership is not a claim that every kind has a runtime editor, every operation or all negative cases.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Example locks, selection identities/cardinality, links and named catalog references resolve to their exact expected kind/version.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: Frozen synthetic reference relationships are not approved vendor facts or exhaustive local import validation.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Empty and partial drafts retain unanswered values; reopening does not invent answers.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: Private local draft shape is not a valid complete BuildSnapshot by default.

domain_invariants.scope: T3, T4 and T5 local draft state
domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Independent activation combinations retain their associated inputs.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: Retained input is not active evaluation authority; registry activation metadata does not replace adopted planning policy.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Aliases cannot mutate revisions; restore appends a new identity and preserves current metadata, including restoration to matching content.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: These source cases are not a complete immutable archive, corruption or installed lifecycle inventory.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Stale, missing and foreign tokens cannot overwrite current state; duplicate edits are no-ops and racing writers have one winner.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: JVM concurrency controls do not establish a service-side conditional update protocol.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Malformed, truncated, unknown-field and unsupported-version bytes remain intact; corruption blocks save rather than resetting to an empty draft.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: This row does not generalize one private format to the neutral wire contract or all historical formats.

domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: Explicit test injections and JVM file locks are not physical power-loss, process-death or installed-device proof.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Diagnostic strings exclude user inputs.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: This focused diagnostic assertion is not the complete security/privacy surface or an accepted policy review.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Both directions follow direct adjacency; modes include old/new active edges, and removed or disabled identities remain rechecked without editing input.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: No transitive policy expansion is inferred. Graph-reader receiving work remains with its existing owner.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: The frozen activation truth table is explicit; cycles, self-loops, duplicates and ordering produce finite deterministic output.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: This is bounded local invalidation, not proof of all newer domain decisions or service graph behavior.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Candidate identity preserves revision; version, meter, region and currency cannot silently fall back; start is inclusive and the conservative end is exclusive.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: A screened candidate still requires evidence review and is not a verified price or final estimate.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Missing conditions and estimated prices stay unresolved; alternatives stay ambiguous, duplicate IDs and malformed/reversed intervals reject.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: No absent source, availability, tax, region or currency fact is fabricated.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Pinned synthetic rates, quantity-times-rate amounts and subtotal/tax/total reconcile with Decimal arithmetic.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: Frozen example reconciliation is not real pricing, a measured cost or full current cost-domain implementation.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Legacy verified does not imply an actual source reading or independent support; reviewed support requires an explicit matching assessment and does not erase estimated/user origin.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: This tests presentation semantics, not the truth of external evidence or approval of its use.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Pinned identity and absent date stay explicit; current capture time is used without age expiry, and new captures cannot mutate historical presentation or reuse support.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: No polling cadence, external source execution or latest factual status is established.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Out-of-order results, duplicate retries, cancelled work and foreign tickets cannot replace current output; concurrent terminal callbacks have one winner.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: These coordinator cases do not prove native scheduling or all UI lifecycle journeys.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Changing any bound draft/artifact input invalidates pending work even at the same revision; replacing capacity evidence rejects an earlier result.
domain_invariants.remaining_boundary: The identity gate does not certify the correctness or sufficiency of the bound estimate.

domain_invariants.expected_outcome_from_source: Foreign locks and duplicate identities reject before a report; ambiguous selection references remain unknown rather than selecting the first match.

recorded_executions.qualification: Canonical receipt explicitly qualifies 82 new projection-version cases while retaining prior cases. This source inventory validates the factory/method references; it performs no new execution.
